report.summary: Integrated Modal component with Discover tab to display architect details when clicking scraped cards. Added state management, click handlers, API integration, and visual feedback for clickable cards.

files_modified.description: Added three state variables for modal management (discoverModalOpen, discoverModalArchitect, discoverModalLoading) around line 952. Created handleDiscoverCardClick function (lines ~1288-1330) that checks if architect is scraped, opens modal, and fetches fresh details from API. Created closeDiscoverModal function to reset modal state. Modified Discover tab card rendering (lines ~1878-1920) to make scraped cards clickable with cursor-pointer styling, hover effects, and 'Click to view details' hint. Added stopPropagation to checkbox label to prevent card click. Added Modal component (lines ~1943-1953) inside Discover tab conditional to display ArchiDetails component with fetched data.

report.notes: Modal integration complete. Scraped cards in Discover tab are now clickable and open a modal with fresh architect details fetched from the API. Non-scraped cards remain unaffected. Checkbox selection still works independently. All acceptance criteria met. No TypeScript or linting errors.
